cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've already invited them. Would borrowing enough chairs for everyone turn that into a yes?
